players.product: long-haul / middle-mile fiber construction for hyperscaler data-center interconnect

quarterly_data.signal: Record quarterly revenue of $2.01 billion, +45.6% YoY and +16.7% organic; adjusted EBITDA $315.5 million (+54% YoY, 15.7% of revenue, above the high end of outlook); adjusted EPS $5.29 (+45%). Communications revenue $1.608 billion (+16.7% organic) 'driven by robust fiber-to-the-home programs, increased long-haul and middle-mile fiber infrastructure builds, and growing maintenance and operations services'.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue $2.01B (+45.6% YoY, +16.7% organic); adj. EBITDA $315.5M (15.7% margin); adj. EPS $5.29 (+45%)

quarterly_data.signal: Data-center interconnect fiber: additional long-haul and data center interconnect awards this quarter bring total contracted backlog for long-haul, middle-mile and inside-the-fence fiber to over $1 billion, with hundreds of millions of dollars of work already performed. 'Cloud migration, AI workloads, and data center growth are driving unprecedented demand for long-haul fiber corridors and high-strand interconnects, as evidenced by the wave of major nationwide builds announced publicly', each validating and expanding the $20 billion addressable market identified more than a year ago (back-half-loaded toward the end of the decade), with 'marked acceleration in overall industry activity in calendar 2027'.
quarterly_data.figure: long-haul / middle-mile / inside-the-fence fiber contracted backlog >$1B; $20B addressable market; industry acceleration in calendar 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Record total backlog of $12.2 billion ($10.98 billion Communications, $1.26 billion Building Systems); total book-to-bill 1.2x (1.1x organic); $6.47 billion expected to be completed in the next 12 months. Long-haul work 'is not one program, that is not one customer' - it spans small and very large programs across customers and geographies.
quarterly_data.figure: record total backlog $12.2B (Communications $10.98B); book-to-bill 1.2x; $6.47B to be completed in next 12 months

quarterly_data.signal: Building Systems (Power Solutions data-center electrical in the D.M.V. region plus National Technology Integrators structured cabling, acquired this quarter): revenue $397.5 million, about 20% of total, adjusted EBITDA $97.2 million or 24.5% of segment revenue; NTI contributed ~$22.9 million; FY2027 segment outlook raised to $1.58 billion-$1.65 billion including ~$90 million from NTI in 2H, with margins in the high teens to low 20s. 'Electricians are still in short demand ... there are still projects that we are turning away.'
quarterly_data.figure: Building Systems revenue $397.5M (~20% of total), adj. EBITDA margin 24.5%; FY2027 segment outlook $1.58B-$1.65B

quarterly_data.signal: FY2027 outlook raised to $7.48 billion-$7.66 billion of total contract revenues (36.5% total growth and 11.3% organic at the midpoint), including a ~$150 million deferral of wireless equipment-replacement revenue into FY2028; Communications $5.90 billion-$6.01 billion. Q3: revenue $1.90 billion-$1.98 billion, adjusted EBITDA $281 million-$302 million, adjusted EPS $4.33-$4.79.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 revenue $7.48B-$7.66B (+36.5%, +11.3% organic); Q3 revenue $1.90B-$1.98B, adj. EBITDA $281M-$302M, adj. EPS $4.33-$4.79; $150M wireless deferred to FY2028

quarterly_data.signal: Long-haul execution capacity: 'There is a lot of training that has to happen if you're going to do long-haul fiber splicing'; around 17,000 people on the communications side and a workforce of nearly 21,000, with a new flagship training facility in Georgia opening in 1H calendar 2027. Communications margin pressure (13.6%, -134 bps YoY) reflects investment to ramp customer fiber programs, the wireless deferral and ~35 bps of fuel cost.
quarterly_data.figure: ~17,000 communications workforce, ~21,000 total; training facility opens 1H calendar 2027; Communications adj. EBITDA margin 13.6%

quarterly_data.signal: Fiber-to-the-home revenue up nearly 60% in 1H vs prior-year 1H, with all customers reaffirming their build programs; BEAD field engineering revenue recognized in the Northeast, with construction starting in earnest in FY2028 / calendar 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: fiber-to-the-home revenue +60% in 1H; BEAD construction begins calendar 2027
